Our Story

Our Origin

Founded in 2013, AstroLabs was built with one mission in mind: simplify and accelerate Gulf market entry. What began as a small, dedicated team has matured into a powerhouse platform supporting over 1,800 companies, from nimble startups to global enterprises – across 37 industries and 50+ countries. Using a blend of cutting-edge technology and hands-on expertise, we drive sustainable growth and successful expansion in the region

Our Mission

We help high-growth companies scale across the Gulf with a digital-first, end-to-end setup experience

Founded in Dubai

AstroLabs is established with a bold vision to simplify business expansion across the Gulf. The founding team hosts one of the region’s first tech ecosystem gatherings, drawing over 500 global tech leaders to Dubai

Our Core Values

Our values are at the heart of everything we do, shaping how we partner with clients, communities, and governments across the Gulf

Excellence

Striving for the highest quality in every aspect of our work, aiming to exceed standards and expectations. We believe in continuous improvement, dedication to craftsmanship, and delivering exceptional results

Customer Obsession

Prioritizing the needs and satisfaction of our customers above all else. We actively listen to their feedback, anticipate their requirements, and go the extra mile to offer personalized and effective solutions

Ambition

Embracing a forward-thinking and pioneering spirit, we set bold goals and challenge ourselves to innovate and lead in our industry. Our drive to achieve great things fuels our progress and success

Ownership

Taking personal accountability for our actions and decisions. We treat the company’s assets and reputation as our own and are committed to the long-term success and sustainability of the business

First Business Success Index Reveals Factors for Thriving in Saudi Arabia

The updated 2025 report draws on 1,200+ international companies to introduce the first Saudi Success Index, identifying localization, compliance, and market integration as top success drivers, while urgency to enter increased by 33% YoY.

Read more

Business Expansion Activity Across Saudi Arabia Sees 4X Increase Since 2018

The 2023 Saudi Market Entry Report analyzed responses from 660 high-growth firms, revealing a fourfold acceleration in market entry timelines (from 8–12 months down to ~2 months), and that 91% of entrants hire local talent within 4 months.

Saudi Construction Sector Guidebook: 30+ Regulations, Licenses & Key Stakeholders Mapped

AstroLabs releases the first comprehensive guide to Saudi Arabia’s construction sector, outlining over 30 regulatory requirements, licensing steps, and key public and private stakeholders. Designed for local and international players, this guide simplifies entry into one of the Kingdom’s fastest-growing industries and aligns with Vision 2030 development priorities.

8 Years of Record Growth: AstroLabs Launches Sector Guidebook on Saudi Tourism to Explore Untapped Opportunities

The guidebook, titled “Inside the Kingdom’s Tourism Draw,” offers a nuanced understanding of the immense potential of tourism to foster economic growth and drive the Kingdom’s diversification, detailing how the sector has fared over the past years.

Catapult Expands to Saudi Arabia to Deliver World-Class Brand Experiences

Catapult, the global full-service live experience agency with offices in Dublin, London, New York, and LA, has announced its strategic expansion into Saudi Arabia. The company's entry into the Kingdom is supported by AstroLabs, the Gulf's leading business expansion platform.

UK-based Design & Technology Firm, Cross Works (XW), Chooses Saudi Arabia as its Regional Headquarters

Cross Works (XW), a global award-winning cross-disciplinary design & technology firm, has expanded to Saudi Arabia and chosen the Kingdom as its Regional Headquarters in the GCC. The move marks the company’s official foray into Saudi Arabia with support from AstroLabs, the Gulf’s leading business expansion platform.

5dVR expands to Saudi Arabia with AstroLabs to Fuel Growth of the VR and AR Sectors

5dVR, a virtual reality content and production studio, has expanded to Saudi Arabia with AstroLabs, the Gulf’s leading business expansion platform. The move aligns with 5dVR’s mission to enable a wider range of businesses across multiple industries to adopt and make use of augmented reality (AR), mixed reality and virtual reality (VR) technologies.

Aurora Media Worldwide Expands to Saudi Arabia, Redefining Sports and Entertainment Content

Aurora Media Worldwide, a multi-award-winning production house providing content services across live and non-live channels, has just announced its expansion to Saudi Arabia and the opening of its new office, facilitated by AstroLabs, the Gulf’s leading expansion platform.

Footballco’s 14 Million Saudi Reach Drives Fan Engagement in the Kingdom

Footballco has strengthened its presence in the Kingdom with the launch of its regional headquarters in Riyadh, underscoring rising demand for localized, content-driven football engagement in the lead-up to landmark events such as the 2034 FIFA World Cup.

How to Get a Foreign Investment (MISA) License in Saudi Arabia

A clear walkthrough of obtaining foreign investment licenses—covering license types, entity structures, required documentation, and application processes.

Comparison Between Branch Office and Subsidiary (LLC) in Saudi Arabia

Selecting the right business structure, whether a subsidiary or a branch office, is one of the initial steps towards setting up a business in Saudi Arabia. This guide will help you navigate the processes and requirements for each type.

Saudi Arabia Business Setup: Key Saudization Updates in 2026

Compliance with Saudization requirements is a non-negligible aspect of a complete business setup and company registration in Saudi Arabia.

This compliance places foreign companies on a path towards sustainable financial growth, making them uniquely positioned to bid on governmental projects and gain access to financial support and incentives for training programs.

How Can Foreign Companies Achieve a Successful Launch and Operational Readiness in Saudi Arabia?

As exciting as it is to expand into Saudi Arabia, many companies can be unaware of the regulatory matters necessary to get their operations off the ground. While market entry remains the primary focus, if a company is unprepared for change, it risks falling behind due to poor operational readiness.

The Saudi Hiring Playbook: Q&A on Compliance and Workforce Setup

We’ve prepared this guide to answer key questions around hiring and employment compliance in Saudi Arabia, helping businesses new to the market navigate regulatory requirements, manage risk, and establish operations compliantly from day one.

Saudi Arabia Business Setup 2026: Myths vs. Realities

Drawing on our experience working with over 900 firms that have already set up a business in Saudi Arabia, we address the most common misconceptions about company formation, highlighting the gap between widespread assumptions and the realities of doing business in the Kingdom.

Expanding to Saudi Arabia: Licenses, Launch Strategies & Cost Breakdown

​​Join us for an insightful session as we explore what it takes to launch and expand your business in Saudi Arabia.

We’ll cover licenses, legal requirements, key regulations, and setup costs - giving you a practical roadmap to navigate the Saudi landscape.

​​Don't miss this chance to get expert tips on budgeting, planning, and making informed decisions for a smooth expansion.

Register now

Saudi Business Expansion: 2025 Recap and What’s Ahead in 2026

​Get ready to unlock the Saudi market! Join us as we dive into the biggest trends, opportunities, and lessons from 2025, and explore what’s on the horizon for 2026. Our experts will share insider tips on market entry, winning strategies, and building a strong local presence.

​Whether you’re planning to expand to Saudi Arabia or aiming to grow your existing footprint, this webinar will give you actionable insights to stay ahead. Stick around for the live Q&A to get your burning questions answered and take your expansion plans to the next level!

Register here

Saudi Business Registration: Advantages of Having a Local Entity

Join our bite-sized webinar, featuring a fireside chat with two of our experts as they explore the benefits of establishing a local entity in Saudi Arabia. Learn why having a local presence is crucial for winning contracts, attracting clients, and building a strong regional network.
